ModMetaData.name: Just Start
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
You configure the game. Just Start deals you the hand.
Just Start is a controlled-random-start framework. It removes the optimisation-heavy pre-game choices (starting tile hunting, pawn rerolling) while preserving every normal choice you make about scenario, storyteller, difficulty, and world generation.
Scenario defines constraints. Just Start randomly selects within those constraints.
After you finish configuring your world, use the Just Start button to auto-select a valid starting tile and generate your starting pawns (and, where applicable, ideology) without the usual reroll loop.
Includes five example scenarios that double as a public XML framework for mod authors: The Kindred, The Prisoner, I Got This, Mountain Dwellers, and Randy's Choice.
DLC-aware: works with Core alone, and gains extra capabilities when Ideology, Biotech, and Odyssey are active.
